description: Frozen archive input manifest for user-confirmed eleven original width2048 circle tasks, new derivative p1,p3,p5; excludes equal_semicircles as prior negative control. No archive simulation rerun. Old ours means initialized Chebyshev/action-word closure, not the new derivative dictionary.

quadrant_grouped.description: Eight points in a 70-degree quadrant arc; four positive then four negative labels.

quadrant_alternating.description: The same 70-degree quadrant arc, with alternating labels at every point.

quadrant_pairs.description: The same 70-degree quadrant arc, with alternating same-sign pairs.

quadrant_center_edges.description: A narrower 45-degree quadrant arc; four central positives and two negatives at each edge.

equal_mixed_odd.description: The same equal spacing; neighboring positive and negative pairs plus isolated signs, preserving opposite antipodal labels.

near_equal_grouped.description: Near-equal 40-to-51-degree circular gaps; four consecutive positives followed by four negatives.

two_clusters_grouped.description: Two separated 36-degree clusters of four points; one positive cluster and one negative cluster.

two_clusters_split.description: The same two clusters, each split into a positive pair followed by a negative pair.

three_clusters_mixed.description: Three clusters of sizes three, two, and three around the circle; positive, negative, and mixed labels respectively.

one_outlier_grouped.description: Seven points in a 60-degree arc with grouped labels, plus one remote negative outlier.

two_outliers_alternating.description: Six alternating points in a 60-degree arc, plus two remote outliers of opposite signs.

equal_semicircles.reason: User-confirmed exclusion of the previous negative-control geometry.

definition.description: Eight exactly equally spaced points; one positive and one negative semicircle, with opposite antipodal labels.

equal_semicircles.note: The original seed20260920 geometry is reused exactly as negative_confirm1 with fresh seed20260921. All other original easy cases remain included.

excluded_variant_groups: confirmation group1 is outside original eleven-task scope

unavailable_other_original_tasks.four: Exists only at width512; outside user-confirmed original qualitative suite.
unavailable_other_original_tasks.eight: Exists only at width512; outside user-confirmed original qualitative suite.

reference_policy: Every new model and old baseline uses the same archived per-case selected dense pair. Use scaling_discovery_analysis01 for quadrant_pairs and two_outliers_alternating, and diverse_analysis01 for the other nine included cases. Individual model numerical tolerances may differ from the paired dense reference tolerances.
selection_policy: Reuse exact primary/refined paths. Old selection uses latest two attempted levels, including failures; no favorable-score selection or fallback.
executed_dependency_hash_policy: For each producer, include all maintained code/ modules in archived source_hashes plus the complete directly/transitively imported study-module graph: common benchmark/diverse_benchmark/diverse_dictionary/diverse_cases; add diverse_refine for targeted original extras; add scaling_benchmark/scaling_dictionary/scaling_cases for scaling trajectories. These are archived digests, not a fresh current-source verification. Broad source maps contain unrelated later-added helpers and mutable README.
